name: Project-Utopia
description: Tool-grounded multi-channel benchmark for LLM hierarchical decision-making, stale-coherence memory failures, and cross-vendor channel routing. Released as a deterministic simulator + 6 procedurally-generated scenarios + 4 verbatim LLM prompts + scoring code.
comment: Repository URL anonymized for double-blind review; replace post-acceptance.

distribution.name: github-tarball

distribution.name: determinism-tier3-manifest

distribution.name: prompt-environment-director
distribution.description: Verbatim system prompt for the environment-director channel (weather, events, faction tension).

distribution.name: prompt-npc-brain

distribution.name: prompt-strategic-director

distribution.name: scenario-blueprints
distribution.description: Procedural blueprint generator covering the 6 scenarios: temperate_plains, fortified_basin, fragile_coast, arid_canyon, alpine_pass, river_delta.

recordSet.name: BenchmarkRows
recordSet.description: Per-(cell, scenario, seed, dim) row in the NDJSON output emitted by scripts/benchmark-paper.mjs (Node) or `project-utopia run` (Python). Each row records one dimension score for one experiment cell.

field.name: cellId
field.description: 9-cell cross-vendor routing matrix cell ID (e.g. FB=Fallback-Baseline, SS=Single-Snapshot, LC=LayerCast).

field.name: scenario
field.description: One of the 6 scenario blueprints used for procedural map generation.

field.name: seed
field.description: Seeded RNG value (often a hex literal like 0xC0FFEE = 12648430).

field.name: dim
field.description: Dimension key; one of the 19 normalizer-registered keys across the 5 dimension plugins.

field.name: raw
field.description: Raw plugin-emitted score (native units; may be cost-form, symmetric, or unbounded depending on dim).

field.name: sandwichNorm
field.description: MeltingPot-style sandwich-normalized score: (agent - fallback) / (oracle - fallback), where fallback is FlatBaselineAdapter and oracle is ScriptedOraclePolicy.

field.name: bayesianMean
field.description: Beta-Binomial posterior mean from ScoringEngine; bounded to [0,1].

field.name: bayesianCi95
field.description: Bayesian 95% credible interval bounds (2-element array: [lower, upper]).

field.name: agentId
field.description: AgentAdapter implementation identifier (e.g. MultiBackendAdapter, FlatBaselineAdapter, LayerCastAdapter, NoopAgentAdapter).
